about_the_game:
It may be bitterly cold, but the frigid landscape of Alberta, Canada, is teeming with life - if you know where to look. Discover and track 19 species through the snow, tackle 13 engaging missions, and explore from the pine-covered peaks down to the frost-swept grasslands to find the perfect hunting spot - but watch out for falling trees, a sign that the preserve’s most industrious inhabitant is active!

DEVELOP YOUR HUNTING MASTERY

Discover Askiy Ridge’s diverse wildlife, some exclusive to the region, but all adapted to survive in sub-zero temperatures. The deep snow reveals tracks, but where do they lead? Spot the Manitoban elk or the mighty wood bison among the 19 species roaming the frozen landscape. If you’re hunting by the water’s edge, be alert for the sound of falling trees; this is the territory of the industrious North American beaver.

EXPLORE THE FRIGID CANADIAN WILDERNESS

If you’re bold enough to brave the snow, the wildlife in the Alberta Preserve is plentiful. Start your hunt at altitude in the dense boreal forests before heading down into the rugged foothills. Moving onwards, the contrasting sightlines of the grasslands afford easy spotting for snow geese and dusky grouse - an advantage even the most experienced hunters will appreciate.

JOURNEY INTO ALBERTAN CULTURE

Experience the diversity of the Albertan ecosystem, home of the First Nations, with 13 location-exclusive missions to complete. Help the warden and local experts to maintain the preserve on the trail of the secretive Sasquatch, and showcase your expertise with challenges designed to test even the most skilled hunters. To top it off, enjoy an epic soundtrack inspired by the wilderness and native cultures of Alberta.

EXPAND YOUR FIREARM COLLECTION

The new Laperriere Outrider .30-30 is a lever-action rifle with a side-loading and side-ejecting design, suited for small to medium game, like the whitetail deer or the gray wolf. Compatible with a wide range of rifle scopes, it is a versatile and powerful choice for hunting at any time of day or night.
